description: Angela Wright sends Patricia Hawkins a formal progress update on the 30-day workforce vulnerability map deliverable — confirming the scope, the three-tier classification system, the role-by-role matrix format, and the projected completion timeline. Angela notes that service technician and F&I officer clusters will be completed first due to highest EV/AV displacement exposure. She frames the methodology as 'repeatable and scalable,' subtly establishing intellectual ownership before the document is delivered and positioning the framework as the seed of a future consulting engagement.
